summary:
Turn 91 built the end-to-end client-completion observation and it works — the operation survives a NOOP recovery all the way to a reply.

What was observed locally. The harness admits a client operation with the real handler (one pending proposal), delivers the NOOP commit that a recovery would broadcast, drains the re-proposed operation from the propose channel, then runs the normal rounds with a peer through the real codec and applies the re-proposed instance with the real executor. The run reports: operation_admitted with pending 1; operation_reproposed true; reproposal_committed with the new instance (0,1) at status 4 (COMMITTED) at both the owner and the peer; and client_reply_after_recovery with executed true, 17 bytes written and replied true — the client's connection received its reply after the recovery had replaced the original instance with a NOOP.

Product. A second artifact on the same unit (unit-C5-noop-commit-reproposes-admitted-operation): a new plan and harness whose prerequisite is the admitted operation, whose property asserts replied == true on the reply event, and which correlates the two through the instance identity with the existing re-proposal binding. The limitations are stated: the harness supplies the client's reply writer (so it observes the bytes the implementation wrote rather than a socket) and one operation with one re-proposal round is exercised. This closes the limitation the first C5 check carried — that the re-proposed operation's later commit, execution and client reply were not driven — and it also supersedes the obstacle recorded last turn, which was about a different, simpler harness.

Frontier. With this artifact submitted, every confirmed protection and defect in the run now has at least one observation that follows its mechanism to the point that matters: the two headline consequences on a driven history, the crash on a constructed history, the codec failure at the receiver's decoder, the startup probe, the inert feature, and both protections end to end. Twelve claim families stand, the map is current at version 19, two candidates remain paused with scoped resume conditions, and the residue is a short list: the reader-side reaction to a displaced stream (not exercisable in-package), the configuration premises that decide whether the delay, durable and transitive-skip paths are active, and the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
